selection_basis: 240-case development: dense weight 0.5 and graph weight 0.1; graph improves one complete evidence group without Recall@20 regressions. Rerank40 improves Recall@20 from 88.44% to 92.15% and complete groups from 80.83% to 86.25%; measured rerank40 p95 is 2.845s on the CPU baseline.

resources.basis: CPU development run 240 real API calls: warm p95 about2076ms and peakRSS about1.315GB; conservative limits frozen before held-out execution.
